proposals.schemaAndDataEffect: Replace the project update trigger with a strictly monotonic finite updated_at token; revoke direct PUBLIC execution. No existing project backfill or deletion.

proposals.schemaAndDataEffect: Add bounded invoker RPC with ordered row locks and captured-content comparison. A later user merge atomically updates the retained memory and deletes the other selected records. Applying SQL alone changes no memories.
